name: Google
short_desc: External: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts and YouTube on your own Google client.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Your Google accounts in Wizard, signed in with your own Google Cloud OAuth client. Tokens stay on this box; apps and agents get only the operations you allow, per account. Set up inside the app.

form_fields.label: External: Owner tailnet logins
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated Tailscale logins allowed to use the page inside the Wizard shell.

form_fields.label: External: Gateway owner secret
form_fields.hint: Required: the owner-authenticated gateway must inject X-Wizard-Owner-Token. Keep this secret out of agent environments and browser code.

form_fields.label: External: MCP admin secret
form_fields.hint: Optional bearer for MCP from outside this box.
